missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Письмо' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'лежало', which agrees in the neuter. 'На столе' gives the prepositional location. A clean introduction to this neuter noun.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Письмо' is the accusative object of 'написал'; neuter inanimate nouns keep the same form as the nominative. 'Длинное' agrees in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Genitive after waiting. 'Письма' is the genitive required by 'ждать' for an awaited thing. 'От друга' adds a second genitive, the source of the letter.
Strategic focus: Dative after an emotion. 'Письму' is the dative governed by the short adjective 'рад', which expresses being glad about something. 'Этому' agrees in the neuter dative.

Strategic focus: Instrumental after an adjective. 'Письмом' is the instrumental governed by 'доволен', which takes the instrumental for the thing one is pleased with. 'Этим' agrees in the neuter instrumental.

Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Письме' is the prepositional form after 'в', expressing location of content within. 'Хорошая новость' is the nominative subject, with 'была' agreeing in the feminine.
Strategic focus: Accusative object with a method phrase. 'Письмо' is again the accusative object of 'отправил'. 'По почте' uses the dative after 'по' to express the means of sending.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Письма' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'лежали'. 'Старые' agrees as a plural adjective, and 'на столе' gives the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Письма' is the accusative plural of 'прочитал'; as a neuter inanimate noun it keeps the nominative-plural form. 'Все эти' agree in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Письма' is the genitive required by the negation 'нет', which marks the missing thing. 'Твоего' agrees in the neuter genitive.
